topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct in the employee handbook; POL-05 rules of behavior approved 2026-09-25
gap: Annual acknowledgments not yet collected
remediation: Collect POL-05 acknowledgments from all 60 staff

control_description: No board (private LLC). The CEO and COO review security quarterly, starting 2026-09-25
gap: Only one oversight review has taken place
remediation: Hold and minute quarterly security reviews

control_description: Information Security Officer designated in writing; roles, reporting lines, and risk acceptance authority in POL-01
Background checks for all hires; annual awareness training; security engineer hire approved for 2027 Q1
gap: No role-based training for privileged administrators
remediation: Role-based training for platform, managed services, NOC, and IT staff

control_description: Control owners named in POL-01 and P02; sanctions statement in POL-01 4.7
gap: Sanctions process not yet exercised; owners' performance goals omit security duties
remediation: Add security duties to position descriptions

control_description: Risk register, SIEM, and asset lists support control operation
evidence: P01; SIEM source list; asset spreadsheet
gap: Asset inventory incomplete for BMCs and network devices; management-plane logs missing
remediation: Single inventory with discovery; onboard missing log sources (POAM-010)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies approved and published 2026-09-25; annual training; incident reporting line to the NOC
gap: Procedures missing for most control families
remediation: Write procedures under each policy

control_description: MSA states security and availability commitments; status page; security contact for customers
gap: No customer-facing system description; bank-designated contacts stale (9 of 14)
remediation: Verify bank contacts (POAM-019); draft the SOC 2 system description

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service commitments defined in the MSA: 99.95% and 99.9% availability, confidentiality, 72-hour incident notice
First risk assessment completed 2026-07-31 using NIST SP 800-30 (P01)
Not assessed
gap: No fraud or misuse risk assessment, including privileged staff misusing administrative tools
remediation: Add insider misuse and fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Major changes are not assessed for risk before they happen
gap: No change process that triggers risk review
remediation: Change process with a risk and significant-change field (POAM-015)

control_description: Mock control assessment by an independent assessor 2026-08 (P07); annual penetration test
gap: No continuous monitoring of control operation
remediation: Continuous monitoring plan with quarterly control checks

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reviewed monthly by the COO

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: FedRAMP Class C control list selected as the baseline (P02, P03)
gap: 139 of 180 base controls not fully in place
remediation: Remediation roadmap (P03 section 4)

control_description: Technology general controls for access, change, and operations defined in P02
gap: Access, change, and backup controls weak at the data center layer
remediation: POAM-001, POAM-007, POAM-015

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-25
gap: Procedures not written
remediation: Procedures by control owners

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Hardware-key MFA for workforce SSO, cloud, code repository, and RMM console; bastion for hypervisor administration; encryption with cloud keys
gap: Hypervisor managers and BMCs use shared local accounts without MFA; customer administrator MFA optional; signing key unprotected
remediation: POAM-003; POAM-004; customer MFA required from 2027-01-31

control_description: Accounts created from approved HR tickets through the IdP
gap: Terminations up to 3 business days late; local accounts removed by hand
remediation: Same-day disable and local account checklist (POAM-001)

control_description: Role-based access in the portal and cloud IAM
gap: All platform engineers are full administrators; control plane credentials reach every hypervisor manager; shared RMM accounts
remediation: POAM-002; POAM-005

control_description: Colocation badge, biometric, and camera controls (carved-out subservice organizations); company cages locked; escort for vendors
evidence: DC-1 SOC 2 Type 2 review (vendor-soc2-review.csv); DC-2 visit
gap: The company does not review its cage access list or cage entry logs, which the DC-1 report lists as complementary user entity controls
remediation: Quarterly access list review and monthly entry log review

control_description: Self-encrypting drives cryptographically erased before disposal
gap: No destruction certificates or disposal log
remediation: Certified destruction vendor (POL-04 4.6)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Edge firewalls, WAF, DDoS scrubbing; bastion for management access
gap: Management network reachable from the NOC network; RMM console open to the internet
remediation: POAM-002; POAM-006

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher for portal, API, and control plane; IPsec between sites

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on laptops, NOC workstations, and cloud workloads; templates signed in CI
gap: No EDR on hypervisor managers and the bastion; template signatures not verified at deploy
remediation: EDR on management servers; signature verification at deploy

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly external scans; IaC drift checks for the cloud tenant
gap: No authenticated internal scanning; no hardening baselines for hypervisors and BMCs
remediation: POAM-013; POAM-016

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM for IdP, cloud, and EDR events; 24x7 NOC availability monitoring
gap: No monitoring of hypervisors, BMCs, network devices, or the RMM tool; AI auto-close without sampling
remediation: POAM-010; POAM-011; POAM-012

control_description: Analysts review High and Critical alerts; security incidents tracked in tickets
gap: Low-scored alerts closed by AI without review; incidents not categorized
remediation: Weekly sample of auto-closed alerts (P10); security ticket category

control_description: POL-03 and the P08 runbook approved 2026-09-25
gap: Not tested; bank contacts incomplete
remediation: Tabletop 2026-12-15 (POAM-018); contacts (POAM-019)

control_description: Nightly control plane backups; paid VM replication to DC-2
gap: No recovery runbook; restores never tested
remediation: POAM-008; POAM-009

control_description: Pull requests with one approver for control plane code; infrastructure-as-code for the cloud tenant
gap: Data center changes unrecorded and unapproved; hotfixes bypass review
remediation: POAM-015; POAM-017

control_description: BIA completed (P05); cyber insurance with an incident response panel; two carriers per site
gap: No contingency plan; DC-1 loss would strand about 70% of VMs
remediation: Contingency plan (POAM-008); replication offer before hurricane season

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor contracts managed by the Controller; DC-1 colocation SOC 2 reviewed 2026-09-02
gap: RMM and SIEM vendors never reviewed; no security or incident notice terms; DC-2 report last reviewed 2024
remediation: POAM-020

control_description: NOC tracks cluster capacity monthly; 20% headroom rule for hypervisor clusters; cloud tenant autoscaling
Colocation power, cooling, and fire protection (carved out); DDoS scrubbing; nightly backups; replication for about 30% of VMs
gap: Backups not immutable or separated; control plane RPO not met
remediation: POAM-007

control_description: No recovery testing
gap: Recovery plan never tested
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; annual DC-1 failover exercise (POAM-009)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classification approved 2026-09-25; MSA confidentiality clause
gap: Data inventory by location not complete
remediation: Complete the data inventory in the SSP

control_description: MSA: customer data deleted within 30 days after contract end; VM volumes zeroed on release

remediation: Deletion ticket with evidence at each contract end; certified destruction
